items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: because one of my students, Gerald – Gerald Clayton - was playing with his father.

ctx.x: You said you went out last night to hear some music.
Yeah, I went out to hear the Clayton Brothers, because one of my students, Gerald – Gerald Clayton - was playing with his father. It was amazing. He’s an amazing young man.
That’s great. Where was the performance at?
